title: 01 — Twoja muzyka
description: 0–2 s, 48f. AI-assisted music: anonimowy twórca naciska raz Enter na zwykłej klawiaturze komputerowej. Bliski kadr prawej dłoni w grafitowym rękawie przy drewnianym biurku. Ekran całkowicie poza kadrem, brak interfejsu, padów i grania na instrumencie. Napis montażowy «Twoja muzyka.» pozostaje osobną warstwą.

prompts.image: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit the supplied opening Start Frame for the same AI-assisted music creator. Preserve the anonymous adult's RIGHT hand identity and charcoal knitted sleeve, walnut desk, warm lamp from left, subdued cyan ambient light and photorealistic cinematic material texture. Replace the entire music pad controller with an ordinary compact black COMPUTER QWERTY keyboard. Reframe as a much closer oblique overhead insert: right hand entering from lower right, index fingertip poised just above the ordinary horizontal Enter key on the right of the main letter block, about to press it ONCE. Natural relaxed remaining fingers, exactly five digits, wrist supported on desk. Realistic standard ANSI keyboard layout and normal small white key legends; Enter label correctly spelled, not oversized. Keyboard at natural diagonal across middle/lower frame. Remove ALL beat pads, rotary controllers and musical instruments. Crucially, NO SCREEN surface or software interface anywhere in view: crop the laptop entirely out, only desk, keyboard, hand, a little coffee cup at left and the warm light are visible; background upper quarter soft and quiet for the existing separately typeset caption. Do not add text overlays, logos, holograms or an artificial AI button. Keep portrait9:16,1080x1920, close tactile framing, believable finger/key scale. This is a normal computer action, not playing an instrument.
prompts.animation: 0.0–0.6s: the creator's right index fingertip presses the existing Enter key once, depressing it only a few millimetres. 0.6–1.2s: the fingertip releases and the key returns to its original height. 1.2–3.0s: hold naturally. Camera: locked close oblique insert. Secondary motion: a slight crease at the charcoal cuff and natural fingertip compression on contact. Continuity: preserve the single right hand, five-finger anatomy, keyboard geometry and all existing key legends. The other fingers remain relaxed; desk objects stay stationary. The screen remains completely outside the frame. Use the first two seconds in the edit. Avoid typing sequences, extra hands, changing letters, camera movement, cuts, overlays or watermarks.
